$comment: Central configuration. Every generator/validator reads this file. Override any value with the matching YUHANA_* environment variable (see src/config.py).

ssiptv.$comment: Limits taken from SS IPTV operator documentation and Smart-TV memory constraints.
ssiptv.$comment_navigation: Sports and Kids stay as one alphabetical list each: the owner asked to browse them straight through, and pagination already keeps any single screen inside the tile budget.

health_gate.$comment: Refuses to publish a validation run that looks like a vantage-point failure rather than a real outage. Only active once a baseline of previously-ACTIVE channels exists.

validation.$comment_reliability: Default 0.5: a channel that is up more often than not earns a tile. Bangladesh gets more latitude at 0.25 because it is the priority market and validation runs from a US datacentre, which inflates failure rates for BD-hosted streams; Green TV, Desh TV, Global TV and Channel S were all being withheld on distance rather than on being broken.
validation.$comment_slow_degraded: DEGRADED covers three unrelated conditions: a slow origin (plays, just starts slower), an unfetchable segment or variant (black screen), and the holding state for a channel that failed once but not enough times to be condemned. Publishing only ACTIVE conflated them and dropped T Sports HD from the Bangladesh screen on 38 of 46 successful probes. A channel is re-admitted only when the recorded reason is latency, consecutive_failures is 0, and reliability is at least slow_degraded_min_reliability.

security.$comment_https: OFF, and it should stay off. This was switched on assuming SS IPTV refuses plain-http streams as mixed content. That assumption was never tested and was wrong: the owner's original working playlist was 31% plain http and played fine. The gate removed 333 channels including AXN, Star Movies, HBO, Sony Max and Star Sports. The other gates here are evidence-based; this one was not.
security.$comment_denied_hosts: Two groups. URL shorteners hide the real origin, so the stream cannot be judged and the target can change under us. Pluto's stitcher builds a per-session ad-stitched manifest that is geo-restricted and expires, so a URL that validated is dead later.

policy.$comment: Content-rights gating. 'require_rights_review' blocks a source from the published playlist until a human sets redistribution_allowed.

movies.$comment: Movie library tuning. min_rating_top_rated gates the Top Rated collection; min_playable_bytes rejects a 'movie' that is really an error page or a trailer.
movies.$comment_min_rating_publish: Withhold a film whose IMDb rating is BELOW this. A film with no rating is kept: not knowing is not the same as knowing it is bad. Set to 0 to disable.
movies.$comment_runtime: A movie library must hold movies. Archive collections are full of ephemeral shorts, talks and test footage; 60 minutes is the feature threshold and an unknown runtime cannot be confirmed as a feature.
